brief: Long two-storey Italianate brick block of 1872 on a corner: brick piers dividing the bays, round-arched upper windows with ornate hoods, a bracketed cornice with a name panel at the corner, and a ground floor of cast-iron piers framing many shopfronts.

facade.notes: the Union Block (Wellington OH, 1872): a two-storey red brick block with tall round-arched windows under cast hood moulds and a corbelled cornice; a restaurant's projecting sign ('FORT'S'), storefronts being restored behind scaffolding

why.note: the two-part block: shops below, offices or flats above
